Sent from Yahoo Mail for iPhone

Hi Nicholas,

Thanks for coming back to me, and for your patience on this one.

Nothing more you need to do. The $50 is on its way to your card, and your BS-2 order stays exactly as it is, same order number, nothing lost by waiting. As soon as the manufacturer confirms a dispatch date I'll write to you at this address with it, and you'll get tracking the moment it leaves the warehouse.

If anything changes on your side in the meantime, or you just want a status check, reply here and I'll pick it up.

Thanks again for sticking with us, Nicholas.

Sarah, HeliumDeploy Support
